metadata.title: Context and Tooling Security

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for securing AI context injection and structured tool invocation, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and similar mechanisms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI context management, structured tool invocation, retrieval-augmented generation, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how external context and tools are authorized, constrained, and monitored within AI and agentic systems.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides adversary-centric context for execution, defense evasion, and impact techniques facilitated through AI tool misuse.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-native threat taxonomy for prompt injection, context poisoning, and tool-based privilege escalation.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats exploiting inference-time inputs, retrieved context, or structured prompts to override AI controls or intent.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where injected context alters model behavior or expands effective authority beyond approved scope.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.value: Tool Misuse and Indirect Action Abuse
props.remarks: Threats involving unsafe or unauthorized use of tools, APIs, file systems, or network calls by AI systems.

metadata.remarks: Context and Tooling Security governs how AI systems consume external context and invoke tools. It exists to mitigate AI-native risks such as prompt injection, context poisoning, and tool-based privilege escalation that arise when models are connected to external knowledge sources or action-capable tools.

components.title: Context Provenance and Scope
components.description: Validation and scoping of external context provided to AI systems, ensuring authenticity and authorized use.

implemented-requirements.remarks: External context supplied to AI systems is validated, attributed to a trusted source, and constrained to approved scope.

components.title: Tool Invocation Authorization
components.description: Explicit authorization controls governing which tools an AI system may invoke and under what conditions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI systems are permitted to invoke only explicitly authorized tools, with enforced parameter and action constraints.

components.title: Capability Revocation and Containment
components.description: Ability to revoke, restrict, or contain context and tool capabilities dynamically when misuse or risk is detected.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI system access to context and tools can be dynamically limited or revoked in response to detected misuse or risk.
